title: Rugs

# Rugs

# Introduction

Rugs are made from the hides of their respective creature types, while carpets are made from jute. Both are used as decorative objects.

## Common properties

Rugs and carpets share the following properties:

• Property: Durability | Value: 50

• Property: Support | Value: Wood (from 10 to 100)

• Property: Loss | Value: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal

• Property: Resistances | Value: Weak: Chop Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pickaxe, Fire, Frost, Lightning Resistant: Pierce Immune: Poison, Spirit

• Property: Damaged by Rain? | Value: No

• Property: Comfort | Value: 1 (if no other rugs/carpets in range)
